---
name: safety-oracle
description: Portable compiler safety checks.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [requester, assistant]
---
contract @infinity => expired
type question
type answer
 question: ref(question)
type restart
state new
 requester -> assistant: question() awaits answering
  => answer() & complete
   | @1m & complete
state answering max_entries 1 => complete
anystate
 requester -> assistant: restart() => new
end complete

error.detail: new is the initial state and cannot be re-entered
